content.text: Docs IA audit v1 / 信息架构审计与提案 (work-agentos-docs-information-architecture-v1)

Audited at integrated d3bc126 against the live agent-company Store (23 Documents, 161 Blocks, 177 Relations, 177 TypedRecords; docs health = 0 critical / 9 warning). ALREADY TRUE: the Dashboard default tree already excludes archived Documents (apps/agent-dashboard/src/company-os/docs/fixtureAdapter.ts:700) and drops BusinessModules whose root Document is archived (same file:706-711), and an archived Document reached by deep link renders an explicit archived-history banner (BasicDocumentPage.tsx:767). NOT TRUE YET: (1) there is no explicit archive view or toggle anywhere in the dashboard, so archived material is behind nothing rather than behind an explicit filter — acceptance asks for an archive surface, not erasure; (2) the agent-facing CLI disagrees with the UI — harness company docs query/traverse return archived children inline with no lifecycle filter (crates/harness-cli/src/main.rs:4380-4388), so an Agent and a Human see different trees; (3) related WorkItems and maintained-by actors cannot be derived from canonical Relations, because 176 of 177 active Relations are document->typed_record source_for and there are ZERO document->work_item and ZERO maintained_by Relations — those panels must be derived by reverse-indexing WorkItem.source_document_ref / context_refs / result_document_ref plus Document.updated_by, or they will ship empty. BLOCKING CAPABILITY GAP: every AgentOS Document is lifecycle_status=draft and no governed command can promote a page to active. document create hardcodes draft (main.rs:5619, no --status flag), template status is the only lifecycle mutator and refuses kind!=template (main.rs:5965-5969), and archive sets archived (main.rs:5787). The realised state machine for a CLI-created page is draft -> archived, terminal; no Document in this Store has ever gone draft -> active. Therefore the default tree MUST be defined as exclude-archived, not include-only-active: filtering to lifecycle_status==active renders the entire AgentOS hierarchy empty (verified by simulation over the live Store). This proposal is design + audit only; it creates no WorkItem, Approval, Finance, Organization or Execution state.
